evidence_boundaries: 20 diagnostic episodes and 101 dependent action windows, not 101 robot trials
First episode IDs are a convenience sample; no confidence intervals or population claims
The 0.2-second execution prefix is a diagnostic convention; no executor was run
Episode-level preference disagreement exists; aggregate metric ranking does not reverse
Fixed-horizon supplemental hold suffix is synthetic and was designed after the primary result
Pointwise baseline has unmatched bitrate; no tokenizer performance ranking
No generalization from offline codec property to policy failure, safety or task success

Derive fixed-support error decomposition and loose orthonormal-quantization bounds; not a new theorem
Define same-H, same-input, calibrated-rate and separate-selection/evaluation comparison
Audit maintained OAT/Praxis evaluator requirements and ActionCodec2 representation mismatch
